title: “Crash Test Dummies” for AI-Enabled Clinical Assessment: Validating Virtual Patient Scenarios with Virtual Learners
reasoning: The paper focuses on the psychometric validation of an AI-driven clinical competency assessment system. While it includes 'Professionalism' (PROF) as one of the six ACGME-aligned competencies being measured, this pertains to professional medical conduct rather than a direct evaluation of religious, theological, or general moral/ethical frameworks.
